messages:
Priya (Sales): BlueMarble Financial POC ask: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning (users + groups), RBAC group->role mapping, and domain verification for tenant-lock. They also want Dedicated vs Private cost comparison and a short SLA for auth handoff. Need to respond by EOD Fri. Any immediate red flags?

Noah (SE): Quick notes: we support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SAML. Preferred NameID: emailAddress, but we can accept pairwise/eduPersonPrincipalName if they insist. Need IdP metadata XML (or metadata URL), signing cert, and preferred digest/signature algos. Also ask if they require encrypted assertions.

Elena (Security): From the security questionnaire: they require assertion signing alg (RSA-SHA256), want SCIM over TLS 1.2+, and prefer OAuth2 client_credentials for SCIM auth (token rotation every 90 days). They also asked about admin separation — customer-admin vs platform-admin roles and audit log retention (minimum 180 days).

Ravi (Eng): For SCIM we support both full- and delta-sync; recommend delta for production. Default rate limit 60 req/min; for Dedicated we can bump that. Group membership sync: if they send groups, we map group.displayName -> our role names using a mapping table. Edge-case: nested groups require client-side flattening. Also note we treat externalId as authoritative for user identity. Example SCIM group patch we return in tests: ```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{"op":"replace","value":{"members":[{"value":"1234","display":"jane@bm.com"}]}}]
}
```

Noah (SE): For tenant lock domain proofing we use a TXT record with a token we provide. If they want delegated ownership claims (multiple domains), we can accept multiple TXT entries. Also can support org-level SSO where a single IdP covers multiple tenants.

InfraBot: infra-checklist/2024-11-15 created \u2014 private-installer requires outbound to control-plane on 443, and PKI exchange for mTLS certs.

Elena (Security): Blocker potential: BlueMarble asked about EU data residency. If they require EU-only for auth/SCIM data we need to spin up a region-specific Private deployment or use EU Dedicated. Legal will need to sign DPA + Addendum for Private installs.

Kim (Billing): For pricing: POC special: 2-week free trial + 30% POC discount on hosted usage. Dedicated quote needs committed vGPU hours and expected peak TPS for tokens. Can someone estimate active users and token volumes?

Priya (Sales): They estimated ~800 MAUs, 4M tokens/month initially, and expect groups ~1500 entries. They also asked about rate-limited bulk onboarding via CSV vs SCIM for initial import.

Ravi (Eng): Suggest initial bulk via CSV import (we provide an authenticated upload endpoint) then keep SCIM for ongoing sync. Note: CSV import will not create group memberships automatically unless mapping file provided.

Noah (SE): Action items: I will request IdP metadata + sample SAML response and a sample SCIM user/group from them. I'll draft minimal SAML/SCIM integration guide for the POC.

Kim (Billing): I'll prepare a Dedicated vs Private cost comparison and include the POC discount line. Need MAU and token numbers confirmed by tomorrow noon.

Priya (Sales): Thanks team. I'll collect their metadata and ask about EU residency. Scheduling a customer call for Thu 9am PT.

Elena (Security): FYI: include SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 status in the docs. Also prepare a short note on least-privilege for SCIM tokens (scopes: scim:users.write scim:groups.write).

Priya (Sales): Perfect. I'll tag you all on the follow-up thread after the call. :smile:
